Get Supporting

GET 
/users/:id/supporting/:supported_user_id

Gets the support from the given user to the supported user

Request​

Path Parameters

    id stringrequired

    A User ID

    supported_user_id stringrequired

    A User ID of a supported user

Query Parameters

    user_id string

    The user ID of the user making the request

Responses​

  • 200

Success

  • application/json
